newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fu Hui says to place 76 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Fu Hui says to place 76 mln new shares.

text.p: Fu Hui Jewellery Co (H.K.) Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to place 75.93 million new shares, or 16.54 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$0.60 each to professional and institutional investors.
The company said the placing price represented a 14.29 percent discount to the closing price of HK$0.70 on Friday.
About 50.5 percent of the net proceeds of HK$45.56 million before expenses would be used for repayment of short term borrowings and the balance for general working capital, the statement said.

On completion of the deal on April 18, the shareholding of major shareholder Fujian Jewellery Import & Export Corp would be cut to 21.53 percent from 25.79 percent, and the stake of Fu Hui's chairman So Sik would be reduced to 24.89 percent from 29.83 percent.
The total number of issued shares of the company will increase to 459 million shares from 383.07 million, it said.
